ci-bot: perf-alert: nightly perf job detected +12% median latency on kernel-selection path after merge of PR #4832 (ref: 2026-03-18T07:04:...). Full matrix: xlarge-gpu, seq=512, batch=8.
ci-bot: failing benchmark: runtime/kernel_selector_bench median 92ms -> 103ms (baseline 92ms). p95 also up ~15%.
mike_g: seeing it too locally on A100 repro with the same model. Repro steps in the CI artifact.
kathy: which commit landed? last merge for that PR was 4832 (optimize kernel tie-breaker) merged into main at 1769489001.
ben: I started a quick bisect on main -> looks like commit 1769487205 introduced a subtle path change in heuristics.
sara: can we avoid a full revert? is this a micro-regression (cost vs latency tradeoff) or a bug?
mike_g: the change made preference for tiled-kernel for short heads when seq>256; seems to increase kernel launch/selection overhead for batch=8.
kathy: if it's just heuristic, we could patch selector to guard with a cheap runtime check. I'll try a patch.
release-manager: status: nightly showed regression -> blocking today's canary release. Recommend stop rollout until hotfix verified.
ben: creating a revert PR now: r/4832-revert-heuristic-default (draft). Also preparing a targeted cherry-pick: patch/4832-guard-check to backport to release-2026-03 branch.
mike_g: @ben drop the minimal change so we can verify quickly. Keep the revert scoped to selector table only.
qa-bot: running perf-smoke on revert-pr (#4841) and on candidate cherry-pick (#4842). ETA ~20m.
ci-bot: perf report for #4841 (revert): median 91ms, p95 140ms -> roughly baseline.
sara: good sign. Let's validate with KV-cache enabled profile (that was where we saw higher variance).
qa-bot: KV-cache profile tests: #4841 shows stable cache hit latencies, no extra micro-scheduling overhead.
kathy: I pushed a micro-patch (PR #4843) that adds a cheap preflight: if batch_size<16 and seq>256 do not prefer tiled-kernel. It's smaller than full revert.
ben: I'll run the canary with #4843 on staging GPUs and compare traces.
mike_g: quick flame snapshot: attached inline (top events): selector_decision -> kernel_launch -> enqueue_wait spike on main, not on #4841.
release-manager: decision: revert PR #4832 from main immediately (we'll merge #4841) to unblock canary. Backport #4843 to release branch as a more conservative permanent fix.
sara: assign owners: @kathy for backport PR, @ben to verify main revert merge, @mike_g to confirm perf gates.
ben: merged revert (#4841) to main. CI green on unit tests; perf job finishing now.
ci-bot: post-merge perf check: median 90ms. Regression closed.
qa-bot: kicked off end-to-end smoke with KV-cache and batching matrix on main (includes long seq and small batch combos).
mike_g: confirming locally with 3 runs: 89ms, 91ms, 90ms. p95 back to normal.
kathy: opened backport PR #4844 against release-2026-03 with the guard and tests. Added a small regression test to exercise selector path.
release-manager: scheduling hotfix window: patch verification 30m from now, then roll to canary next hour.
sara: note for postmortem: add CI perf gate for kernel-selector path that runs the small batch+long-seq matrix. Also capture the flame snapshots on nightly artifacts for future diffs.
ben: will add the perf test and a brief doc describing the selector heuristics and how to tune them (docs/selector-heuristics.md).
mike_g: thanks everyone. Learned: heuristics need microbench coverage and KV-cache interactions in CI.
release-manager: closing loop: canary rollback blocked -> revert merged -> backport queued -> hotfix verify in progress.
ci-bot: log links: /ci/artifacts/1769501123/selector-bench.html, /ci/artifacts/1769501400/flame-main.svg, /ci/artifacts/1769501600/flame-revert.svg
qa-bot: final status (1769501850): hotfix PR #4844 ready, main reverted, perf green. :white_check_mark:
